sql:
SELECT
    sum(f.SalesAmount * er.EndOfDayRate) AS TotalOnlineSalesEUR
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate er
    ON f.DateKey = er.DateKey
    AND er.CurrencyKey = (
        SELECT CurrencyKey
        FROM retail.DimCurrency
        WHERE CurrencyName = 'Euro'
        LIMIT 1
    )
